ConnectionStrings.//: Local development only. Points at the throwaway Docker container documented in backend/README-local-db.md — port 55432, not 5432, so it cannot collide with a Postgres someone already runs on the default port. These credentials guard nothing: the container is local, disposable, and holds only seeded demo data. Production never reads this key; there DATABASE_URL is injected by Render and takes precedence.

Seed.//: Demo data on locally, matching the Render deployment, so a developer sees the same dashboard the deployed site shows. Phase D consumes this; in Phase C it only has to exist and be readable.
